faq.q: When does this Cohort-1 route unlock?
faq.a: Unlocks automatically once >=12/16 (75%) of MVP Slice 1 routes are indexed in Google Search Console.

faq.q: How are API token rates verified?
faq.a: Verified against published vendor API pricing schedules and official NIST/FCC (.gov) standards.

faq.q: Does prompt caching reduce input token costs?
faq.a: Yes, cached input reads reduce token costs by 50% to 90% depending on the model provider.

faq.q: Does Batch API cut both input and output token costs?
faq.a: Yes, asynchronous 24-hour Batch API queues provide a 50% discount on both input and output tokens.
